ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: There are two circles in the image, and the problem statement says that they are congruent. In the left circle there is a chord, the chord is labeled 3x−7, and the smaller arc corresponding to this chord is labeled 76°. In the right circle there is also a chord, the chord is labeled 2x+9, and the arc measure given in the diagram is 284°, so the other arc cut off by this chord is 360°−284°=76°. Because the two circles are congruent, and the arcs cut off by the two chords are both 76°, these two chords are congruent. Therefore 3x−7=2x+9, solving gives x=16.
